title: Evaluation of the Pharmacokinetics of Microdose Midazolam, Dabigatran, Pitavastatin, Atorvastatin and Rosuvastatin in Diabetic Patients

sections.abstract: 1.To explore the functional changes of P-gp, CYP3A4, OATP1B and BCRP in Diabetic patients (including the non-obese T2DM, obese T2DM, elderly T2DM, and T1DM).
